title: Concept: phpLDAPadmin console is reachable without authentication
description: phpLDAPadmin is a full directory editor: it can add entries, change passwords and modify group membership. Serving it publicly exposes the directory schema and gives the caller a ready-made client for any credential they obtain elsewhere.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller enumerates users and groups, and with any directory credential can change passwords or grant themselves membership.
